curriculumAlignmentSummary: Unit 3 of the Grade 10 Computer Science textbook covers programming fundamentals, website development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, front-end vs. back-end), advanced programming constructs (arrays, loops, functions), complex algorithms, and testing/debugging (unit tests, breakpoints, watchpoints). The supplied model and annual papers exhibit varying degrees of alignment, with website development, front-end/back-end distinctions, array methods, and debugging concepts appearing directly or via conceptual parallels in past paper components.

mappings.textbookExerciseCue: differentiate between front-end development, and backend development of a website
mappings.observedPaperForm: Explain why both front-end and back-end development are essential for a dynamic website or name technologies used in front-end development
mappings.controlledTransformation: Translating textbook descriptive sections on client-side/server-side separation into structural justifications and technology listings
mappings.studentPreparationFocus: Memorizing definitions and roles of front-end vs back-end technologies
mappings.textbookEvidenceQuote: website development & maintenance is easier when the front-end and back-end are kept apart
mappings.paperEvidenceQuote: Why both front-end and back-end development are essential for a dynamic website?
mappings.caution: Ensure focus remains strictly on web development context provided in Unit 3.

mappings.textbookExerciseCue: use more advanced programming constructs (lists, etc.) to create dynamic websites using JavaScript as backend scripting
mappings.observedPaperForm: MCQ or short question concerning array manipulation or list methods in JavaScript
mappings.controlledTransformation: Extracting syntax and functional behavior of built-in array methods into direct recall items
mappings.studentPreparationFocus: Practicing array methods such as push(), pop(), and index handling
mappings.textbookEvidenceQuote: You may use 'push()' to add more items to the end
mappings.paperEvidenceQuote: In JavaScript, which method would you use to add a new item to the end of a list?
mappings.caution: Keep distinction clear between standard arrays and abstract lists.

mappings.textbookConcept: Debugging techniques using breakpoints and watchpoints

mappings.observedPaperForm: Describing the importance of debugging or role of debuggers in software development
mappings.controlledTransformation: Converting practical IDE debugging tool descriptions into conceptual evaluation questions
mappings.studentPreparationFocus: Understanding how breakpoints and watchpoints assist in identifying logical errors
mappings.textbookEvidenceQuote: The application pauses at breakpoints and allows you to examine the code
mappings.paperEvidenceQuote: Why is debugging important in program development? (Two reasons)
